description: Pins protocol::derive_person_keypair_wrap_key_from_normalized + protocol::person_id_hash under the v0.2 salt domain 'myne.v0.2 argon2id-person-keypair|'. Two cases, different normalized phrases (hence different person_id_hash values), same salt, so person-level domain separation is pinned: two people never share a wrap key even with the same salt. Vault-independent: the account_number_hash salt slot carries the phrase-derived person_id_hash, not any vault's account hash. EXPECTED RUNTIME: ~6s total. Default-on in `cargo test`; only the regenerator is #[ignore]-gated. Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_person_keypair_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored`.

cases.description: Person-keypair wrap key for the 12-word 'abandon … about' phrase. Its person_id_hash is SHA-256('myne.person-id|' || phrase)[:16], pinned here so the derivation the salt binds is cross-implementation. The phrase is fed raw (already NFKD-normalizable ASCII; the caller normalizes before this call per §3.4).
A DIFFERENT normalized phrase, same salt. Both the Argon2id password and the person_id_hash change, so the wrap key differs from case A: two people never share a wrap key for one salt.
